Title: One more rules question from the weekend

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
I forgot about this one, regarding my very own deck (not in the NERQ, of
course, where I wasn't allowed to play), which I should have
asked before :)

If Demdemeh turns his retainer into an ally, does that ally's life
become a "starting life" attribute, for purposes of effects which need
to know it (like Vagabond Mystic) ?
I was playing it as if that were the case.

Thanks.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The ally's "starting life" doesn't change when he becomes a retainer.
The retainer's "starting life" is the same as the ally's "starting
life".
even if the ally has fewer life (or more life) than his starting amount.
